root_cause: The provider route named mistral-api-eu was allowed to pair with a signed AUTO-region Mistral runtime. The adapter always addressed api.mistral.ai, which is the global endpoint and does not guarantee regional inference. This could misrepresent customer-requested data-sovereignty properties.
prevention_rule: Require verified Mistral EU route to bind tenant profile computeRegion=EU and independently signed claim computeRegion=EU. Use api.eu.mistral.ai for region EU; route AUTO uses global only when no EU route is selected. Require account-specific EU processingRegion and residencyEvidenceId in server-side provisioning; fail closed otherwise. The model directory cannot assert an endpoint claim.

test_evidence.required: EU hostname proof, no global fallback, unsupported region denies before network, readback refused without regional provisioning

outcome.runtime_credential_assurance: requires real provider readback; none invented
